source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The shared helper awaits the dark custom theme unload and its window update before starting the light custom theme. The separate unified-toolbar test still puts dark unload, one event wait and light startup in a single Promise.all, so it has a different ordering contract. The helper has explicit success-path unloads and no added failure-cleanup hook. Harness failure cleanup remains unverified here. This source comparison does not prove a race or a passing test.
title: The shared icon helper separates custom theme teardown from the next startup
